rows.label: Bohemian Rhapsody
rows.description: 1975 Queen song written and composed by Freddie Mercury
rows.hook: stitches a ballad, an opera section and hard rock into one grand suite

rows.label: Mr. Brightside
rows.hook: holds the record for the longest run on the UK singles chart

rows.label: Welcome to the Jungle
rows.hook: opens the album Appetite for Destruction and was voted VH1's greatest hard rock song

rows.label: Smells Like Teen Spirit
rows.description: 1991 original song written and composed by Nirvana; first recorded by Nirvana
rows.hook: pushed grunge into the mainstream as the lead single from Nevermind

rows.label: Bitter Sweet Symphony
rows.hook: has a video of its singer striding down a busy London pavement, bumping into passersby

rows.label: Gangnam Style
rows.hook: is a K-pop hit that went viral worldwide thanks to its funny dance video

rows.label: Seven Nation Army
rows.hook: has a booming bass-like riff made by running a guitar through a pitch shift effect

rows.label: ...Baby One More Time
rows.description: song written and composed by Max Martin; originally recorded by Britney Spears and released in 1998
rows.hook: launched a teen pop star's career with a video set around a high school

rows.label: Take On Me
rows.description: song written and composed by Magne Furuholmen, Morten Harket and Pål Waaktaar, originally recorded by A-ha and released in 1984

rows.label: Call Me Maybe
rows.hook: is a bubblegum pop hit about hoping a new crush will ring back, topping charts in over 15 countries

rows.label: Virtual Insanity
rows.hook: has an award-winning music video that later became an internet meme

rows.label: Blinding Lights
rows.hook: is a retro synthwave track that topped the charts in over 40 countries

rows.label: Sk8er Boi

rows.label: Enter Sandman
rows.hook: is a heavy metal song about a child's nightmares

rows.label: Wannabe

rows.label: November Rain
rows.description: original song written, composed, and performed by Guns N’ Roses; first recorded by Guns N’ Roses and released in 1991

rows.label: Losing My Religion
rows.hook: grew from a mandolin riff and its video won the top prize at the MTV Video Music Awards

rows.label: Under the Bridge
rows.hook: was written about loneliness and staying clean, and is its band's highest-charting single
